role: wave 8 performance: zom20a capture robustness vs mimics (more specific INT 87h window / search start)
mechanism: zom20a live loop 1Fh..2Ch ends with loop 1Fh = E2 F2 at +2Bh, followed by the dead copy 81 C3 E1 10 at +2Dh. Window F2 81 C3 E1 (+2Ch) is unique in zom20a. Replacement FF 26 17 4A at +2Ch turns the loop into E2 FF (loop to +2Ch, CX is always 1 there) which lands on jmp [4A17h]. GSA_callfart1 (+46h: E2 F2 81 C3 00 89) and GSA_callfart2 (+4: E2 F2 81 C3 FF BF) no longer match; HRZ_Grindo_Holics1 (+34h) and Grindo2 (+46h, +1C6h) still match (full copies), so Grindo needs B082's location start. No 2023/2024/counter/peer binary and no other zombie contains F2 81 C3 E1 (scratch/A038/scan.mjs). Cost: the captured zom20a executes one extra opcode (the loop) before jmp [4A17h], i.e. it reaches zombie_entry half a round later.

recommendation: locpatA is a promising defense fix (screen ALL +0.0062, at the bar; threat zz0ny +0.047 lo>0 with callfart +0.081 and Grindo +0.111, both 6/0). It is B082 locA2 plus a 4-byte window change that answers callfart, which locA2 could not. Field gain over locA2 is ~0 (paired +0.0004), so as a stand-alone promotion it is unlikely to clear the pooled z=2.5 gate; better to include the window change (mov ax,081F2h / mov dx,0E1C3h, or dw 081F2h + mov dx,0E1C3h) in any combination that uses locA2 or rev0's A startup. Watch the strong group (sstrong-3 -0.12); a follow-up should screen locpatA + parB to test whether cancelling the half-round capture delay removes it. patA alone: not promising.
